newsitem.title: USA: Korean peace talks put off to Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Korean peace talks put off to Saturday.

text.p: Peace negotiations between the United States and the two Koreas will take place on Saturday after the North Koreans failed to attend meetings scheduled on Friday, a U.S. official said.
The official said the negotiations, which adjourned inconclusively on Wednesday after all sides said progress was made, will resume on Saturday at 10 a.m. (1400 GMT).
South Korean and U.S. delegations waited all through Friday for the North Koreans to participate, but North Korean officials said they had to consult with their capital, Pyongyang.

The meeting was called to hear Pyongyang's formal response to a year-old U.S.-South Korean proposal for four-party peace talks that would finally close the books on the 1950-53 Korean War by replacing the fraying armistice with a peace treaty.
